limitations.Easy_pairing: Same official API seed and policy seed are paired parameters; identical unobserved simulator RNG states are not asserted.
limitations.bootstrap_zero_success: All-zero task-success bootstrap intervals are degenerate empirical intervals, not proof that population success probability/difference is exactly zero.
limitations.dispatch_unit: MADE environment_calls is original tool_attempts, not all RPCs or oracle calls; DW environment_calls is action returns. Full original RPC/oracle/initialization/tick fields remain in episode/candidate data.
limitations.generalization: Two already observed MADE chemistries and two Proteomics worlds do not establish task generalization; new Easy has only one API seed per theme in this snapshot.
limitations.local_analysis_wall_reason: Not instrumented in the initial asynchronous local CPU invocation; not reported as zero.
matched_conditions: frozen G0 and frozen P/P+C heads
limitations.resource_context: P1 preserves source references and observed episode/whole-job ledgers. It does not reconstruct an identical-hardware, identical-load, identical-timing comparison for every arm.
limitations.risk_comparison: Online arm-specific AUROC/Brier use different selected trajectories and are not same-example P-vs-P+C comparisons; original offline development P/PC comparison is same-row but previously inspected.
limitations.snapshot: Sequential read window, not an atomic statement of current live processes.
limitations.support_meaning: Feature/schema/strict token-target mapping availability only; not evidence of calibration on unseen themes.
limitations.workload_counts: Tokens, generation calls and additional capture forwards are direct work-count evidence; no FLOP/currency conversion is claimed.

policy: Qwen3.5-4B frozen G0 and fixed P/P+C heads

uncertainty.generalization: conditional on observed tasks/worlds; not a task-generalization interval
uncertainty.prediction_unit: whole episodes; no interval if a stratum has fewer than two
uncertainty.unit: complete matched cases jointly resampled across arms within observed chemistry/world strata
